profile.headline: TS-Cleared Full-Stack Software Engineer | React, TypeScript | Enterprise Applications, UX-Focused Frontend Development & Performance Optimization
profile.jobTitle: Front-End Software Engineer | DoD Contractor | Active TS Clearance
profile.summary:
TS-cleared Software Engineer with experience building enterprise applications and high-traffic consumer platforms, specializing in React, TypeScript, frontend architecture, and UX-focused development.
My background combines software engineering, growth strategy, and user experience, allowing me to approach development through both a technical and business lens.
Currently, I work on mission-critical enterprise applications supporting large-scale operational systems, where I focus on responsive frontend development, accessibility improvements, scalable component architecture, interactive data visualization, and modern UI systems using React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and AG Grid.
Previously at Storyblocks, I partnered closely with Growth, Product, and Design teams to optimize user flows, improve performance, increase experimentation velocity, and contribute to measurable booking and conversion growth across a platform serving millions of users.
I’m passionate about building intuitive digital experiences that connect business goals with user needs while maintaining scalability, accessibility, and performance.
Core areas:
• React & TypeScript
• Frontend Architecture
• Tailwind CSS & Modern UI Systems
• AG Grid & Interactive Interfaces
• Accessibility & Responsive Design
• Enterprise Applications
• SEO & Performance Optimization
• GitLab CI/CD
• Cypress & Jest Testing
• UX-Focused Engineering
• AI-Assisted Development Workflows
Active Top Secret (TS) Clearance

positions.title: Front-End Software Engineer | DoD Contractor | Active TS Clearance
positions.description:
• Develop and maintain enterprise applications supporting Department of Defense (DoD) operational workflows within TS-cleared environments.
• Build scalable frontend applications using React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, and AG Grid.
• Design and refine complex data-driven interfaces, including employee management systems, workload planning tools, reporting dashboards, and interactive grid experiences.
• Refactor large legacy frontend codebases into cleaner, reusable, and maintainable component architectures aligned with modern engineering standards.
• Improve accessibility, responsive behavior, and enterprise UI consistency across desktop and mobile applications.
• Implement advanced AG Grid functionality including grouped rows, dynamic cell rendering, custom overlays, interactive pills/tooltips, and responsive data visualization patterns.
• Collaborate closely with backend engineers, designers, QA teams, and stakeholders in Agile sprint environments to deliver production-ready features.
• Support GitLab CI/CD workflows and frontend testing initiatives using Jest, Vitest, Cypress, and Playwright.
• Contribute to frontend architecture decisions, reusable UI standards, validation patterns, and shared component systems across enterprise applications.
• Optimize frontend performance, usability, and user workflows through UX-focused engineering and iterative UI improvements.
• Integrate modern frontend tooling and AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate delivery and improve engineering efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Key Accomplishments:
• Addressed critical bugs, improved system stability, and enhanced the overall user experience for responsive web design for both desktop and mobile user interface.
• Facilitated collaboration amongst Developers, Product Managers, Design, and QA to integrate new and existing features.
• Executed iterative Agile A/B testing on innovative features, enhancing performance, and refining user conversion journeys.
• Implemented Builder.io components, doubling experiment velocity.
• Mentored junior and aspiring software engineers, providing guidance in coding best practices, problem-solving techniques, and professional development.
• Active member of employee resource groups: SURGE (Society for Under-Represented Genders in Engineering) and BSB (Black Storyblocks resource group)
positions.insights: User Experience Design (UED), Tailwind CSS and +22 skills

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Key Accomplishments:
• Specialized in SEO, resulting in substantial improvements in Google Lighthouse and accessibility scores.
• Led the successful migration of Selenium-based test suites to the Cypress framework, optimizing test execution speed and improving overall test reliability.
• Improved SEO scores and site crawlability.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Key Accomplishments:
• Led Re:Stock initiative, developing the campaign's landing page.
• Improved overall SEO, resolved visual identity discrepancies, and made metadata/copy updates.
• Led a lightning talk session introducing Tailwind CSS, elucidating its benefits in simplifying front-end workflows and improving code maintainability. Positive reception led to increased framework adoption in subsequent projects.

educations.schoolName: The Art Institutes of Atlanta, GA
